title: Tor & Dark Web Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your privacy risk when using Tor browser and accessing the dark web. Get personalized safety recommendations and threat assessment.
description: Assess your privacy and security risks when using Tor browser and accessing the dark web. This calculator evaluates your setup, browsing habits, and threat model to provide a personalized risk score and actionable safety recommendations.

formula: const usageRisk = { 'general-browsing': 10, 'research': 25, 'circumvention': 40, 'activism': 60, 'dark-web': 80 }[torUsage]; const setupBonus = { 'default': 0, 'hardened': -15, 'bridges': -10, 'vpn-tor': -20, 'tails': -30 }[torSetup]; const locationRisk = { 'free-country': 5, 'some-censorship': 25, 'heavy-censorship': 50, 'authoritarian': 80 }[location]; const activityRisk = { 'legal-browsing': 5, 'sensitive-research': 20, 'marketplace-browsing': 50, 'file-sharing': 40, 'high-risk': 90 }[activities]; const opsecBonus = (5 - opsecLevel) * 10; const deviceBonus = { 'unsecured': 30, 'standard': 10, 'secured': -5, 'dedicated': -15, 'airgapped': -25 }[deviceSecurity]; const risk = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, usageRisk + locationRisk + activityRisk + setupBonus + opsecBonus + deviceBonus)); const grade = risk <= 20 ? 'A': risk <= 35 ? 'B': risk <= 50 ? 'C': risk <= 70 ? 'D': 'F'; const threat = risk <= 20 ? 'Very Low Risk': risk <= 35 ? 'Low Risk': risk <= 50 ? 'Moderate Risk': risk <= 70 ? 'High Risk': 'Very High Risk'; return { overallRisk: risk, riskGrade: grade, threatLevel: threat };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your Tor privacy risk by analyzing your usage patterns, security configuration, geographic location, online activities, operational security practices, and device security. Higher risk scores indicate greater potential for surveillance, traffic analysis, or legal consequences.
tips: Always use the latest Tor Browser version and never install additional plugins or extensions
Consider using bridge relays if Tor is blocked in your country or you want extra anonymity
Combine Tor with a VPN for additional protection, but understand the trade-offs
Use Tails OS or a dedicated device for maximum security when accessing sensitive content
Never download files or enable JavaScript when browsing high-risk dark web content
